description: In repos/activity-api/src/lib/posterior-update.ts, stop awarding positive alpha credit to executions whose trace metadata records information_yield "idle". The file already has an abstention mechanism: the UpdateSummary interface declares skipped_reason with the arms 'all_deterministic' and 'ungraded_reach'. Add a third arm 'idle_yield' to that union and skip the variant_performance_metrics posterior UPDATE when the execution trace metadata field information_yield equals "idle", exactly as the existing skip arms do. Do not change the behaviour for information_yield values "productive" or "error", and do not touch the beta path. Context: boredom-vessel/src/index.ts line 3728 already reads this same field and discounts it to IDLE_REWARD 0.2, but grep -rn information_yield repos/activity-api/src currently returns zero hits, so the trace store credits idle work at full alpha. Measured consequence: activity docs-mgmt:docs-decision-deliver has total_executions 1495, success_rate 0.987 and thompson_alpha 728.9 while every one of its traces carries impulses_created [] and metadata.information_yield "idle".
